title: Cancer Free — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: acoustic folk fingerpicked guitar Spanish French language learning quiet warm baritone 96bpm gentle brushed drums trilingual true story family relief intimate
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
May 2022. Six words.
"Kerry had the call yesterday from the doctor and she is cancer free."
Joel sent six words. That were the whole story.
Cancer free.

[Verse 2 - Spanish, with English translations]
Mayo de 2022. Seis palabras. (May 2022. Six words.)
"Kerry recibió la llamada ayer del médico y está libre de cáncer." (Kerry had the call yesterday from the doctor and she is cancer free.)
Joel envió seis palabras. Que eran toda la historia. (Joel sent six words. That were the whole story.)
Libre de cáncer. (Cancer free.)
La clase de lectura que haces dos veces (The kind of reading you do twice)
Antes de dejar que sea verdad. (Before you let it be true.)
Seis palabras que llevan seis meses. (Six words that carry six months.)
Libre de cáncer. (Cancer free.)

[Chorus - French, with English translations]
Sans cancer (Cancer free)
Kerry (Kerry)
Sans cancer (Cancer free)
L'appel est arrivé (The call came through)
Sans cancer (Cancer free)
Le mot que le médecin a utilisé (The word the doctor used)
Sans cancer (Cancer free)
Joel a envoyé six mots (Joel sent six words)
Qui étaient toute l'histoire (That were the whole story)
Sans cancer (Cancer free)
Kerry — sans cancer (Kerry — cancer free)

[Bridge - all three]
English: We don't know what the months looked like. We know what came after. Cancer free.
Spanish: No sabemos cómo fueron los meses. Sabemos lo que vino después. Libre de cáncer. (We don't know the months. We know what came after. Cancer free.)
French: Nous ne savons pas à quoi ressemblaient les mois. Nous savons ce qui a suivi. Sans cancer. (We don't know the months. We know what came after. Cancer free.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Cancer free — Kerry — cancer free
Spanish: Libre de cáncer — Kerry — libre (Cancer free — Kerry — free)
French: Sans cancer — Kerry — sans cancer (Cancer free — Kerry — cancer free)
